    return document.querySelector('meta[' + attr + '="' + name + '"]');
  }

  function setMeta(name, content, attr) {

    }

      .replace(/^http:/i, 'https:')

      .trim();

  function getArticleTitle() {

      document.querySelector('.post-title') ||

      'article .post-body p',

    for (var i = 0; i < selectors.length; i++) {
      var elements = document.querySelectorAll(selectors[i]);

      for (var j = 0; j < elements.length; j++) {

  setMeta('summary_large_image', 'summary_large_image', 'name');

  if (articleTitle) {
    setMeta('twitter:title', articleTitle, 'name');

    document.querySelector('[itemprop="articleBody"]') ||

  var mainImage = null;

     --------------------------------------------------------- */

  function normalizeImageUrl(url) {
    if (!url) return '';

    */

      url.indexOf('blogger.googleusercontent.com') !== -1 ||
      url.indexOf('googleusercontent.com') !== -1
    ) {

        .replace(/\/s\d+(-c)?\//i, '/s1600/')

     --------------------------------------------------------- */

    var img = images[i];

    var possibleSrc =
      img.getAttribute('src') ||
      img.getAttribute('data-src') ||
      img.getAttribute('data-original') ||
      img.getAttribute('data-lazy-src') ||
      img.getAttribute('data-image');

    var normalized = normalizeImageUrl(possibleSrc);

    if (!normalized) continue;

    /*

    */

    var lower = normalized.toLowerCase();

    if (
      lower.indexOf('transparent') !== -1 ||
      lower.indexOf('placeholder') !== -1 ||
      lower.indexOf('spacer') !== -1 ||
      lower.indexOf('blank.gif') !== -1
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    mainImage = img;
    break;
  }

    mainImage.getAttribute('src') ||
    mainImage.getAttribute('data-src') ||
    mainImage.getAttribute('data-original') ||
    mainImage.getAttribute('data-lazy-src') ||
    mainImage.getAttribute('data-image');

  if (!mainSrc) return;

     MAIN IMAGE SEO
     --------------------------------------------------------- */

  /*
     Important:

    if (articleTitle) {

     This helps Google discover the principal image faster.
  */

  mainImage.setAttribute('decoding', 'async');

    mainImage.getAttribute('src').indexOf('data:image') === 0 ||

     OPEN GRAPH IMAGE

     --------------------------------------------------------- */

  setMeta('og:image:secure_url', mainSrc, 'property');

  setMeta('twitter:image', mainSrc, 'name');

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------
     IMAGE ITEMPROP
     --------------------------------------------------------- */

  if (!mainImage.getAttribute('itemprop')) {
    mainImage.setAttribute('itemprop', 'image');
  }

     PROCESS OTHER ARTICLE IMAGES
     --------------------------------------------------------- */

  for (var k = 0; k < images.length; k++) {

    var image = images[k];

       Add meaningful ALT to images that have no ALT.
       We intentionally do not overwrite existing ALT text.
    */

    var alt = cleanText(image.getAttribute('alt') || '');

    if (!alt && articleTitle) {

    if (!image.getAttribute('decoding')) {
      image.setAttribute('decoding', 'async');

    if (!image.getAttribute('loading')) {
      image.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
    }

    */

    var src =
      image.getAttribute('src') ||
      image.getAttribute('data-src') ||
      image.getAttribute('data-original') ||
      image.getAttribute('data-lazy-src');

          src.indexOf('googleusercontent.com') !== -1

      ) {

     --------------------------------------------------------- */

    ) {

  */

    var imageSchema = {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "ImageObject",

    schemaScript.type = 'application/ld+json';

     --------------------------------------------------------- */

  );

    preload.rel = 'preload';
    preload.as = 'image';
    preload.href = mainSrc;

     --------------------------------------------------------- */

    var imageMeta = document.createElement('meta');

    imageMeta.setAttribute('itemprop', 'image');
    imageMeta.setAttribute('content', mainSrc);

    document.head.appendChild(imageMeta);
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------
     END
     --------------------------------------------------------- */

<script>

/* =========================================================
   تحت الضوء الإخبارية
   DARK MODE CONTROLLER
   ========================================================= */

(function () {

    'use strict';


    /* =====================================================
       STORAGE
       ===================================================== */

    var STORAGE_KEY = 'tdDarkMode';


    /* =====================================================
       LOAD SAVED MODE
       ===================================================== */

    function loadSavedMode() {

        try {

            if (
                window.localStorage &&
                localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) === 'on'
            ) {

                document.documentElement.classList.add('td-dark');

            }

        } catch (e) {}

    }


    /* =====================================================
       CREATE BUTTON
       ===================================================== */

    function createDarkButton() {

        var existing =
            document.getElementById('td-dark-btn');


        if (existing) {

            return existing;

        }


        var button =
            document.createElement('button');


        button.id =
            'td-dark-btn';


        button.type =
            'button';


        button.setAttribute(
            'aria-label',
            'الوضع الليلي'
        );


        button.setAttribute(
            'title',
            'الوضع الليلي'
        );


        button.setAttribute(
            'aria-pressed',
            'false'
        );


        /* =================================================
           ICONS
           ================================================= */

        button.innerHTML =

            '<svg class="td-moon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">' +

                '<path d="M20.7 15.3A9.1 9.1 0 0 1 8.7 3.3A9.2 9.2 0 1 0 20.7 15.3Z"></path>' +

            '</svg>' +


            '<svg class="td-sun" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">' +

                '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" fill="currentColor"></circle>' +

                '<path d="M12 2v2 M12 20v2 M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41 M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41 M2 12h2 M20 12h2 M4.93 19.07l1.41-1.41 M17.66 6.34l1.41-1.41" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"></path>' +

            '</svg>';


        document.body.appendChild(button);


        return button;

    }


    /* =====================================================
       UPDATE BUTTON
       ===================================================== */

    function updateButton(button) {

        if (!button) {

            return;

        }


        var isDark =
            document.documentElement.classList.contains('td-dark');


        if (isDark) {

            button.setAttribute(
                'title',
                'الوضع النهاري'
            );


            button.setAttribute(
                'aria-label',
                'الوضع النهاري'
            );


            button.setAttribute(
                'aria-pressed',
                'true'
            );

        } else {

            button.setAttribute(
                'title',
                'الوضع الليلي'
            );


            button.setAttribute(
                'aria-label',
                'الوضع الليلي'
            );


            button.setAttribute(
                'aria-pressed',
                'false'
            );

        }

    }


    /* =====================================================
       TOGGLE
       ===================================================== */

    function toggleDarkMode(button) {

        var html =
            document.documentElement;


        var isDark =
            html.classList.toggle('td-dark');


        try {

            if (window.localStorage) {

                localStorage.setItem(
                    STORAGE_KEY,
                    isDark ? 'on' : 'off'
                );

            }

        } catch (e) {}


        updateButton(button);

    }


    /* =====================================================
       INITIALIZE
       ===================================================== */

    function initDarkMode() {

        /*
           تحميل الوضع المحفوظ مرة أخرى
           للتأكد من ثبات الحالة.
        */

        loadSavedMode();


        var button =
            createDarkButton();


        if (!button) {

            return;

        }


        /*
           منع إضافة أكثر من Event Listener
        */

        if (
            button.getAttribute('data-td-ready') === '1'
        ) {

            updateButton(button);

            return;

        }


        button.setAttribute(
            'data-td-ready',
            '1'
        );


        button.addEventListener(
            'click',
            function () {

                toggleDarkMode(button);

            }
        );


        updateButton(button);

    }


    /* =====================================================
       START
       ===================================================== */

    /*
       تحميل الوضع المحفوظ بأسرع وقت ممكن
       لتقليل ظهور الوضع الفاتح لحظيًا.
    */

    loadSavedMode();


    if (
        document.readyState === 'loading'
    ) {

        document.addEventListener(
            'DOMContentLoaded',
            initDarkMode
        );

    } else {

        initDarkMode();

    }


})();

</script>
